modules.name: Family Members
modules.description: Lets residents maintain the members of their flat, grouped by age group, with counts shown to the Society Manager and Raghuvir dashboard.

requirements.title: Add customer as first member on approval
requirements.description: When a resident is approved, the system adds the customer as the first family member with relation Self.

requirements.title: My Family screen to add members
requirements.description: Resident opens My Family and adds each member with name, relation and birth year; gender and mobile are optional.

requirements.title: Assign age group from birth year
requirements.description: The system places each member in an age group based on birth year: Kids (0–17), Adults (18–59) or Seniors (60+).

requirements.title: Raghuvir Admin can change age group limits
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can change the age limits that define the Kids, Adults and Seniors groups.

requirements.title: Immediate count updates on summary and dashboard
requirements.description: Member counts update at once on the Society Manager summary and the Raghuvir dashboard.

requirements.title: Yearly automatic age group update
requirements.description: Every year on 1 January the system automatically moves members into their new age group.

requirements.title: Warn on duplicate member in another flat
requirements.description: If the same name and birth year already exist in another flat of the project, a warning is shown and the resident confirms or corrects the entry.

rules.title: Missing birth year counted as Age Not Given
rules.description: A member with no birth year given is counted under Age Not Given.

rules.title: Deactivated flat members removed from counts
rules.description: When a flat is deactivated due to an owner change, its members are removed from all counts, but history is kept.

rules.title: Maximum 15 members per flat
rules.description: More than 15 members in one flat is blocked, with a message to contact the Society Manager.
